title: Azusawa Kohane — Into An Exciting Future〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Alleyway

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...! This one's so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is! I don't know which country this is supposed to be from, but I could spend an entire day walking around here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't forget that we need to head back once it's time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Still...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's interesting how SEKAI can grow by having a new area appear like this...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I couldn't believe it when I found out what had happened.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I'm looking forward to exploring this area on my walks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That's what you're excited about?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, because of how many different countries are represented here. This means I'll get to travel to a new one every day! How amazing is that?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Traveling to different countries... Hehe. That does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I would've brought my camera with me if I'd known this area was going to appear...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I bet the pictures you take in these alleyways are going to look like works of art!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree...
There's these yellow bricks, all the graffiti of people... This place has quite a lot to offer.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Exactly! It's all so new and fresh!
I'm getting drawn to everything I see here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are there any countries that you'd like to visit, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me?
Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've always wanted to go to... Bruges in Belgium!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Bruges...? Can you tell us what it's like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uhh... Some people call Bruges an open-air art museum because of how beautiful it is.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There are a lot of buildings colored this really pretty red and orange, and they have canals with boats that run underneath them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Heehee. I know about that place♪
It's like something from a fairytale, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, yes, that's right!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Really...?
If it's that pretty, then I'd also like to see it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Where else would you like to go?
I'm sure you have more to tell us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Where else? Umm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh.
I'd like to visit the United States. After all, that's the home of street music...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Of course!
You'd get to hear all sorts of fun music there♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, rap originated in New York's South Bronx neighborhood, right? I'd also like to visit there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
London would also be nice to visit.
It'd be fun to see such a historic city firsthand...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, that island in Greece where all the buildings are colored white... Santorini! I'd like to go there!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like there are quite a few places that you'd like to visit, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, there are...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Where else...? Oh, I almost forgot!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like to see the Amazon rainforest!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? The Amazon rainforest?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, because it's home to a lot of different snakes! I'd get to see some of Count Pearl's friends and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
That probably sounded really weird...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, it didn't.
Just a little surprising is all!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But I'd like to explore there as well.
Just think about all the animals we'd get to meet!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. It'd be a wonderful opportunity for us to make many new friends, including Count Pearl. I hope we get to go in the future.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, SEKAI Expedition Team, this place may not be as exciting as a rainforest, but we still have plenty left to explore!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Lead the way, Captain Kohane!
Your orders?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Orders?! Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then... L-Let's head out and keep exploring SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you...
